en.advice: Reduce leaf wetness, mulch soil, remove badly infected lower leaves, and use a labeled fungicide program.

treatments.name: Chlorothalonil-based fungicide (examples: Bravo, others; check local registration)
treatments.when_to_apply: Start at first leaf spots or when past conditions favored disease; continue on the label interval (commonly every 7–14 days) while pressure remains.
treatments.rate: Mix and apply only at the rate on your product label for tomato foliage (g/L or oz/acre as printed). Never exceed the label maximum applications per year.
treatments.notes: Respect pre-harvest interval (PHI) and re-entry interval (REI). Rotate with other FRAC groups to slow resistance.

treatments.name: Azoxystrobin + difenoconazole (or other labeled premix; registration varies)
treatments.when_to_apply: Often used in rotation with contact fungicides during the season as allowed on label.
treatments.rate: Premix products: use packaged ratio only — do not alter concentration beyond label.
treatments.notes: Avoid back-to-back strobilurin-only sprays; partner with chlorothalonil/mancozeb where labels allow.

hi.advice: पत्तों पर गीला कम रखें, मुल्च करें, बहुत संक्रमित निचली पत्तियां हटाएं, लेबल वाला फ़फूंदनाशी कार्यक्रम चुनें।

treatments.name: क्लोरोथालोनिल आधारित फ़फूंदनाशी (स्थानीय पंजीकरण देखें)
treatments.when_to_apply: पहले धब्बों पर या बारिश/ओस के दबाव पर लेबल अनुसार दोहराएं।
treatments.rate: केवल उत्पाद लेबल पर टमाटर के लिए लिखी दर।
treatments.notes: PHI व REI लागू करें। अलग-अलग FRAC समूह घुमाएं।

es.advice: Reduce la humedad en el follaje, usa mulch, retira hojas muy infectadas y aplica un programa de fungicida según etiqueta.

treatments.name: Fungicida con clorotalonil (registro local requerido)
treatments.when_to_apply: Al primer síntoma o cuando haya condiciones favorables; repetir según la etiqueta.
treatments.rate: Solo la dosis del envase para tomate (foliar).
treatments.notes: Respeta IPA, tiempo de carencia y REI. Alterna grupos FRAC.

en.advice: Act fast: improve ventilation, avoid overhead irrigation, remove heavily infected plants when feasible, and follow a protective fungicide program suitable for late blight in your region.

treatments.name: Fluopicolide + propamocarb or similar late-blight–labeled premix (registration varies)
treatments.when_to_apply: Preventively before outbreaks or immediately when weather is cool and wet; interval per label (often 5–10 days under severe pressure).
treatments.rate: Label-only rate for tomatoes; products differ by formulation — never exceed maximum annual uses.
treatments.notes: Combine with cultural controls; late blight spores spread rapidly in humid weather.

treatments.name: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb (protectant) as part of rotation
treatments.when_to_apply: Intercalated with systemic partners where labels permit for resistance management.
treatments.rate: Use manufacturer label rate and coverage volume for thorough leaf protection.
treatments.notes: Alternate modes of action; check potato/tomato host restrictions on label.

hi.advice: तुरंत कार्रवाई: हवा, सिंचाई, संक्रमित पौधे हटाएं; क्षेत्र के लिए उपयुक्त फ़फूंदनाशी लेबल अनुसार।

treatments.name: स्थानीय लेबल पर देर से ब्लाइट के लिए दर्ज प्रीमिक्स / रक्षण

es.advice: Actúa rápido: ventilación, riego al suelo, elimina focos fuertes; programa fungicida regional para tizón tardío.

treatments.name: Premezclas / productos con registro específico para tizón tardío
treatments.when_to_apply: Clima frío y húmedo: intervalo de la etiqueta.
treatments.notes: Rota modos de acción y respeta carencias.

en.advice: Common in humid greenhouses; increase airflow, reduce humidity, avoid leaf wetness overnight, and remove heavily spotted foliage.

treatments.name: DMI or SDHI fungicides labeled for tomato leaf mold (check registration)
treatments.when_to_apply: Begin at first symptoms or preventively in humid seasons; repeat per label until conditions improve.
treatments.rate: Apply strictly per label concentration and water volume for greenhouse or field tomatoes as approved.
treatments.notes: Rotate with non-cross-resistant partners; some populations show reduced sensitivity — scout effectiveness.

treatments.name: Sulfur or bicarbonate-based products (organic options where permitted)
treatments.when_to_apply: Often shorter intervals; avoid high temperature phytotoxicity per label.
treatments.rate: Label rate only; coverage of leaf undersides is important for mold fungi.
treatments.notes: Test on a few plants if unsure of varietal sensitivity.

hi.advice: नम ग्रीनहाउस में आम; हवा बढ़ाएं, रात में पत्ते गीले न रखें।

treatments.name: टमाटर लीफ़ मोल्ड पर लेबल वाला DMI/SDHI फ़फूंदनाशी
treatments.when_to_apply: पहले लक्षण या रोकथाम लेबल अनुसार।
treatments.notes: पत्तों के नीचे का कवरेज महत्वपूर्ण।

es.advice: Frecuente en humedad; mejora ventilación y reduce rocio nocturno en el follaje.

treatments.name: Fungicida registrado para moho foliar del tomate (DMI/SDHI u orgánico)
treatments.when_to_apply: Al síntoma o en prevención según condiciones.
treatments.rate: Dosis de etiqueta; cubrir envés de hojas.

en.advice: Avoid working wet plants, mulch to limit soil splash, stake plants, and begin fungicides early when spots first appear.

treatments.name: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb (protectant programs)
treatments.when_to_apply: Start at lower-canopy spotting; continue 7–14 day schedules while rainy/windy splash conditions persist.
treatments.rate: Label rate for tomato; ensure coverage especially lower leaves where infection starts.
treatments.notes: Rotate with alternative FRAC groups; remove lowest infected leaves to reduce inoculum.

treatments.name: Azoxystrobin or pyraclostrobin-containing products (where labeled & rotated)
treatments.when_to_apply: Use within IPM rotation, not as solo chemistry.
treatments.rate: Strictly label — strobulurin resistance risk exists for Septoria in some regions.
treatments.notes: Partner with multi-site protectants per label recommendations.

hi.advice: गीले पौधों पर काम कम करें, मुल्च से मिट्टी छलकाव कम करें।

treatments.name: क्लोरोथालोनिल या मैकोज़ेब (रक्षक)
treatments.when_to_apply: नीचे की पत्तियों पर धब्बे दिखते ही लेबल अनुसार।

es.advice: Evita dispersar espolvoreo desde el suelo; acolate y usa mulch.

treatments.name: Clorotalonil o mancozeb (protectores)
treatments.when_to_apply: Al inicio de manchas en el estrato bajo.
treatments.notes: Rota FRAC; retira hojas muy infectadas abajo.

en.advice: No clear disease signs. Keep scouting, sanitize tools, and maintain spacing and irrigation at soil level.

hi.advice: स्पष्ट रोग के लक्षण नहीं। निगरानी और अच्छी खेती अभ्यास जारी रखें।

es.advice: Sin signos claros de enfermedad. Continúa monitoreo y buenas prácticas.
